values.note: DCNR state forest motorized campsite rate (a state forest program, not a state park one). The $6.50 reservation fee is non-refundable and charged once per booking.

fees.source: ReserveAmerica's price block for one night (read 2026-11-10): PA residents $10.00 a night ($70.00 a week), non-residents $15.00 a night ($105.00 a week), 'Reservation Fees $6.50', and 'Any applicable taxes will be shown within the shopping cart' (the cart needs a login and was not opened). https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('Motorized roadside, hike-in roadside, equestrian, and rustic campsites can be reserved for a fee of $10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents ... effective as of November 3, 2022'); Michaux camping brochure, elibrary.dcnr.pa.gov docId 3562328 ('DCNR charges a $6.50 non-refundable transaction fee on all reservations and registrations')

values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

note: A gravel parking lot beside Bear Valley Road at the Two Mile Trail junction, in plain view of the road; DCNR rates it for one camper trailer or two vehicles with tents. Imagery shows a gravel patch about 20 m long through the trees. The lot is entered parallel to the road and DCNR lists the driveway as shared. Gravel forest road all the way in: about 4.8 miles from Upper Strasburg Road (OpenStreetMap labels the last 2 miles Broad Run Road). A stream runs about 300 ft away. No toilet; pack out trash. State forest roads get no winter maintenance and are not plowed. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: still listed and bookable online (calendar 'Available' on the nights sampled in Nov 2026, May and Jul 2027), Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle length 50 ft, gravel, slight grade, no site-specific warning text. Fees confirmed and the $6.50 reservation fee added; booking, hookups, season confirmed; toilets/water written as none. Imagery: gravel patch at the pin (within about 5 m). NHD: nearest stream 101 m. Phone 717-485-3148 confirmed on the DCNR and ReserveAmerica pages. Not found: any DCNR alerts page or posted bridge limit for Bear Valley Road (district page as fetched shows no alerts; OSM carries no weight limit on the route).
